test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Himani bought a washing machine for Rs. 8,000 and spend Rs. 500 on its repairs. She sold it at 20% profit. With the money she got by selling it, she bought another washing machine and sold it at 10% loss. What is her overall loss/profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price of first machine (CP₁) = 8000 + 500 = Rs.8500

Profit on first machine = 20%

Selling Price of first machine (SP₁) = Cost Price of second machine (CP₂)

Loss on second machine = 10%

**Formula used:**

Profit = CP × Profit%

Loss = CP × Loss%

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Profit on first machine = Rs.8500 × 20% = 8500 × 0.20 = Rs.1700

⇒ SP₁ = (CP₁) + Profit = 8500 + 1700 = Rs.10200

Loss on second machine = CP₂ × 10% = 10200 × 0.10 = Rs.1020

⇒ SP₂ = (CP₂) - Loss = 10200 - 1020 = Rs.9180

Overall Profit of Himani,

⇒ (SP2) - (CP1) = 9180 - 8500 = Rs. 680

**∴ The overall Profit of Himani is Rs.680.**
